title: Enforce Gate 2.5 as a hard rule: deterministic offline architect-review evidence gate in precheck fast

brief.what_adds: A deterministic offline precheck gate that blocks code/schema/security changes until architect-review evidence for the exact diff exists
brief.problem: Gate 2.5 was honor-system; a session could skip it

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/merge_gate.py and core/run_quality_gate.py to add a deterministic Gate 2.5 check that validates architect-review evidence (config/architect-review.json + config/architect-review-baseline.json) is present and valid before allowing fast-path precheck pass. Wire into /api/v1/gates/go-no-go and /api/v1/evidence/events for evidence recording. Reuse existing gate plumbing pattern from model_gate.py.

assumptions: Gate 2.5 definition and evidence schema already documented in architecture docs
Architect-review evidence is produced by an upstream architect agent or human process
Deterministic means no LLM calls needed — pure config/file validation

Config staleness in architect-review.json causing incorrect baseline comparison
Regression in fast-path performance if evidence index scan is unoptimized
evidence: config/architect-review.json and config/architect-review-baseline.json exist as candidate configs
